name: Exp_SilverTrend_CrazyChart
summary: This EA implements the SilverTrend trading strategy originally developed by CrazyChart, which identifies trend reversal points by detecting price extremes with a volatility-based filter. It generates buy signals when price breaks above a calculated resistance level and sell signals when price breaks below a calculated support level, trading on signal crossovers of the SilverTrend indicator.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了由CrazyChart开发的SilverTrend交易策略，通过检测价格极值并结合波动率过滤器来识别趋势反转点。当价格突破计算得出的阻力位时产生买入信号，当价格跌破计算得出的支撑位时产生卖出信号，基于SilverTrend指标的信号交叉进行交易。
strategy_analysis: SilverTrend策略的核心概念是基于价格极值检测和波动率过滤来识别趋势反转点。入场条件：当SilverTrend指标发出买入信号（价格突破动态计算的阻力线）时开多仓，当指标发出卖出信号（价格跌破动态计算的支撑线）时开空仓。出场条件：通常采用反向信号平仓，即多头持仓在卖出信号出现时平仓，空头持仓在买入信号出现时平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA通常使用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数，缺乏动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面，该策略可能不包含止损设置，完全依赖反向信号进行出场，这在震荡行情中可能导致较大回撤。策略的SSP参数控制信号灵敏度，较大的值产生更少但更可靠的信号，较小的值产生更多但噪音更大的信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the SilverTrend strategy is based on price extreme detection combined with a volatility filter to identify trend reversal points. Entry conditions: a long position is opened when the SilverTrend indicator issues a buy signal (price breaks above a dynamically calculated resistance line), and a short position is opened when the indicator issues a sell signal (price breaks below a dynamically calculated support line). Exit conditions: typically uses reverse signal closure, meaning long positions are closed when a sell signal appears and short positions are closed when a buy signal appears. Position sizing generally uses fixed lots or account-balance-proportional lots without dynamic adjustment mechanisms. Money management is a weak point as the strategy may lack explicit stop-loss settings, relying entirely on reverse signals for exits, which can lead to significant drawdowns during choppy markets. The SSP parameter controls signal sensitivity—larger values produce fewer but more reliable signals while smaller values produce more but noisier signals.

parameters.name: SSP
parameters.description: SilverTrend信号灵敏度周期数，值越大信号越少越可靠
parameters.description_en: Channel calculation period for high-low range

parameters.name: Kmax
parameters.description: 最大波动率系数，用于动态计算支撑阻力通道宽度

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, max loss per trade

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Group TP in points, close all at this profit

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 移动止损点数，0表示不使用移动止损
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 to disable

pros: 信号逻辑清晰，基于价格极值突破，易于理解和验证
自带波动率过滤器（Kmax参数），能根据市场波动自适应调整信号阈值
参数简洁，SSP和Kmax两个核心参数足以控制策略行为，减少过拟合风险
pros_en: Clear signal logic based on price extreme breakouts, easy to understand and verify
Built-in volatility filter (Kmax parameter) that adaptively adjusts signal thresholds based on market volatility
Concise parameters—SSP and Kmax are sufficient to control strategy behavior, reducing overfitting risk
cons: 缺乏明确的止损机制，在趋势反转失败时可能承受较大亏损
纯反转信号策略在震荡市中容易频繁开平仓产生连续亏损
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
缺少点差过滤，在点差较大时可能不利入场
cons_en: Lacks explicit stop-loss mechanism, potentially suffering large losses when trend reversal fails
Pure reversal signal strategy prone to frequent opening and closing with consecutive losses in choppy markets
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening repeated positions on the same bar
Missing spread filter, potentially entering at unfavorable prices when spread is wide
improvements: 增加明确的止损止盈设置，建议基于ATR动态计算止损距离
添加新K线检查和持仓检查，防止同一根K线重复开仓
加入趋势过滤器（如均线方向）和点差过滤，减少震荡市假信号
增加移动止损功能以保护已有利润
improvements_en: Add explicit stop-loss and take-profit settings, preferably ATR-based dynamic stop-loss distance
Add new bar check and position check to prevent repeated entries on the same bar
Incorporate a trend filter (e.g., MA direction) and spread filter to reduce false signals in choppy markets
Add trailing stop functionality to protect accumulated profits

risk_points: 无止损机制依赖反向信号出场，单笔亏损可能较大
震荡行情中频繁反转信号导致连续亏损
缺少新K线检查可能导致同一根K线重复开仓
risk_points_en: No stop-loss mechanism relying on reverse signal exits, single trade loss can be significant
Frequent reversal signals in choppy markets leading to consecutive losses
Missing new bar check may cause repeated position openings on the same bar

It generates buy signals when price breaks above a calculated resistance level and sell signals when price breaks below a calculated support level, trading on signal crossovers of the SilverTrend indicator.
